about.title: About us
about.hero: Durar is not just a shop — it is the story of the earth, shaped by makers who cared for every detail.
about.storyBody1: Our journey starts at the source: gemstone mines and sky-born meteorites, with trusted teams that distinguish verified origins, and a network of rare-collectors spanning the globe. We never accept pieces of unknown provenance, and we never show a piece without a certificate documenting its origin and journey.
about.storyBody2: From rough stone to finished piece, every item passes through expert hands that respect nature's balance: honest cutting, clean craftsmanship, and an authenticity certificate for each piece. What reaches you is the brightest chapter of that story.

heritage.title: Heritage
heritage.body: We preserve each stone's story from its source to your piece; every gem's authenticity begins with respecting where it came from.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.body: Documented certificates and careful inspection before every piece is shown, so its value tells the truth, not just its sparkle.

rarity.title: Rarity
rarity.body: We select pieces rare in formation and grading — not merely the most brilliant ones.

about.visitBody: Come to our showroom to see the pieces under natural light, talk to our experts, and read the certificates yourself.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.hero: A question about a piece, a showroom appointment, or a delivery update — we welcome all of it.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.messagePlaceholder: Write your message here… our team reads every one.
contact.sentBody: Thank you for reaching out — our team will reply within two working days.
